auth.forgotHint: Enter your email and we will send a code.
auth.policyFailed: Unable to load the registration policy. Please try again.

home.noPlanHint: Pick a plan to get started.
home.expiredHint: Expired or out of quota. Renew to restore access instantly.
home.subscribeHint: Import it into your client; servers update automatically. Keep it private.
home.queuedHint: Starts automatically when your current plan expires or runs out of traffic; valid for {{days}} days.
home.queuedHintForever: Starts automatically when your current plan expires or runs out of traffic; no expiry.
home.devicesHint: {{n}} of {{limit}} device slots used. Remove a device you no longer use to free its slot.
home.noDevices: No device has fetched the subscription yet.

plans.title: Plans
plans.couponHint: Have a code? Enter it here
plans.mineQueued: starts after the current plan lapses
plans.mineHint: You can hold several plans at once: servers are combined, traffic is counted per plan. Buying a plan you already have renews it.
plans.mineHintSingle: Only one plan can be active at a time here; switching plans ends the current one.
plans.noteRenew: Extends the current expiry; the traffic quota restarts for the new period.
plans.noteStack: Starts right after payment and runs alongside your current plan.
plans.noteQueue: Paid now, starts automatically when your current plan expires or runs out of traffic.
plans.noteReplace: Your current plan ends on payment and this one takes over.

ask.renewBody: You already have this plan. This purchase extends the current expiry; what you have used stays used. A plan with a reset cycle keeps its cycle, one without gets the new period's allowance added.
ask.stackTitle: You already have an active plan
ask.stackBody: "{{plan}}" can run alongside your current plan: servers are combined, traffic is counted per plan. Or pay now and let it start automatically once the current plan expires or runs out of traffic.
ask.replaceBody: Only one plan can be active at a time here. Buying "{{plan}}" ends your current plan right away.

servers.title: Servers
servers.clientChain: Client proxy chain. Import the complete mihomo, Stash or sing-box subscription; this node has no standalone share link.

invite.title: Invite friends
invite.hint: Share the link; every payment by someone you invited credits {{percent}}% to your balance.
invite.disabledHint: Rewards are off right now, but you can still share the link.
invite.bindHint: Missed it at sign-up? You can add it once here.
invite.commissionHint: Move it to your balance to spend, or request a payout (minimum {{min}}).

redeem.title: Redeem code
redeem.hint: Enter a gift card or redeem code to top up balance, activate a plan or add traffic.

telegram.hint: Link Telegram to check your subscription and traffic in @{{bot}} and get expiry and ticket notices. Send this command to the bot:
telegram.bound: Linked to @{{bot}}; expiry, traffic and ticket notices go there.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.subject: Subject
tickets.closedHint: This ticket is closed; open a new one for a new problem.

loginConsent.title: Sign in with Captain
loginConsent.login: Sign in with a Captain customer account to continue. Staff accounts cannot authorize applications.
loginConsent.profile: Share your stable account identifier and generated display name.
loginConsent.boundary: This does not share your password, balance, subscriptions or administrator access. The application manages its own session.
loginConsent.invalid: This login request is invalid or the application is unavailable. Start again from the application.
loginConsent.expired: This request expired or could not be completed. Start again from the application.

wgDevices.title: WireGuard device subscriptions
wgDevices.hint: Create a subscription for each device. Each WireGuard identity is independent, and usage is charged to the same account.
wgDevices.created: Device created. Wait for the servers to sync before connecting.
wgDevices.revoked: Device revoked. Wait for the servers to sync.
wgDevices.legacyHint: A WireGuard node in the regular subscription supports one independent client. Do not copy the same device subscription to multiple devices.
wgDevices.syncHint: Creating or revoking a device takes effect after the servers sync their configuration.
wgDevices.readOnly: Your role can only view the device list.
wgDevices.name: Device name
wgDevices.revokeHint: Revoke WireGuard access and the subscription for “{{name}}”? Its existing WireGuard configurations will stop working after the servers sync. Other devices are unaffected.
wgDevices.linkHint: This device-only link contains WireGuard nodes for mihomo/Clash, Stash, sing-box and Egern. Keep using the regular subscription for other protocols. For native WireGuard, select a node below to download its configuration.
wgDevices.nativeHint: Select one node, then download and import the file into the WireGuard app. Each file configures this device for that node only.
wgDevices.serverHint: To use this WireGuard node on multiple devices at once, create a separate subscription for each device.
wgDevices.configUnavailable: A valid WireGuard configuration is not available right now. Refresh and try again.

reasons.no_wireguard: No WireGuard nodes are available to this account.
reasons.upgrade_required: The server and proxy core need an upgrade to provide WireGuard device subscriptions. Contact your administrator. Existing device records are retained.
reasons.unavailable: WireGuard service readiness cannot currently be confirmed. Try again later. Existing device records are retained.
reasons.client_chain_unsupported: WireGuard nodes with a client-side dialer chain do not support device subscriptions yet.

wgDevices.sharedHint: Device slots are shared with other registered clients.
